Discover Sharm — Design System

Live reference. Every swatch, size and state below is rendered from the real tokens in style.css, so it can't drift from production.

Color tokens & contrast

Rule: white text only on --brand-600 or darker. --brand-500 is for icons and large display text.

Type scale

Discover Sharm · --text-xl 22
Handpicked hotels · --text-lg 18
Private excursions & transfers · --text-base 16
Secondary information · --text-sm 14
Smallest allowed label · --text-xs 12

Spacing (4px base)

Buttons — all states

Min height 48px (44px hard floor on touch). Tab through them: the focus ring is gold on dark, amber on light.

Confirm dialog

Replaces window.confirm(). Focus starts on the safe choice, Esc and backdrop = keep, Tab is trapped.

Copy patterns

SituationPatternExample
ErrorWhat happened + how to fixWe couldn't cancel your booking. Check your connection and try again, or contact support.
Destructive confirmQuestion names the object; buttons name the actionCancel this booking? → Cancel booking / Keep booking
Auth gateVerb first, no "please login"Sign in to book
SuccessShort, warm, no exclamation stackingThanks. Your review helps other travelers.

RuleStatus
